title: Peter M NDE 3163
content: It was a sunny day. We were in a kindergarten, which was located at the roof of the building. It was breakfast break time. We were playing and my cousin told me that I can fly. I stayed in my place thinking while my two cousins and my brother went away and I climbed the wall and jumped. While I was falling, I saw a very fast movie for what I did at that time. After I hit the ground, I didn't feel anything then suddenly I saw myself falling down in a tortuous well. It was dark and I couldn't see anything but I was able to hear other voices. Some voices were laughing, crying, or speaking. Some of them were falling faster than me. It was frightening and I was trying to find anything to catch. I moved falling for a while. It was a long well, and then I exited from the well to find myself standing at the beginning of a tunnel. There was someone who exited with me but it disappeared. I stayed at my place thinking what to do. It was a long tunnel. At the end of the tunnel, there was a doorway without a door. Outside this door, a very bright light was shining the tunnel. There was nothing to hear or to see. It was just me inside this tunnel and that light. I thought to go back. I looked back and saw darkness I said no way. I thought to stay in my place but did not know for how long I would be staying - I said to myself, 'There is no other way. It is better to go to that life than to stay here. Maybe I will find someone or anything.' I started moving slowly until I reached the middle of the tunnel and everything gone. There is another thing I would like to add. I had remembered something about my past life. The vision of my past life is not clear enough but I remembered that I was in a very dark place. There was nothing to see. I was able to hear voices and I was able to see a light coming from a far but I was unable to reach it. There were no feeling of time. It was a quiet place. The darkness was everywhere. I had all my feelings with all my senses. I was able to move around but I said it is better to stay in a place where you can hear voices; it is better that to go afar. Someone came from the light and said there is an empty place so I start to move to reach that light, but someone was faster than me so I said next time I will be faster. This time I stayed a longer time than the first one then someone came and said there is an empty place so I start moving until I reached the light. The light surrounded me and then I found myself in a very narrow place. After a while, I start pushing to get out of this place. That explains why babies push their mother's stomach. It is an inconvenient place, and then I came out and started crying. I started crying from the light and from the noise, which were unusual things in the place that I come from. The baby can remember his past life for a very short time after birth and it's gone after that. If someone experienced a very dead injury he or she may remember something.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Falling down in a tortuous well, then exited to a tunnel.

arrival.other_being_detail: Someone exited the well with him but disappeared.

environment.environment_other_detail: A long tunnel with a doorway without a door; darkness behind; bright light shining into the tunnel; 'There was nothing to hear or to see. It was just me inside this tunnel and that light.'

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He considered going back because behind was darkness, but decided to go toward the light because 'There is no other way.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell after jumping from a kindergarten roof.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Initial 'tortuous well' with voices; brief 'movie' of what he did while falling; later added past-life/pre-birth narrative involving darkness, distant light, and then being 'surrounded' by light before birth.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Fall/impact followed by falling in a dark well with voices, then tunnel with bright light and doorway/threshold; no clear OBE or return described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Detailed past-life/pre-birth account: darkness with voices, distant light, someone saying 'there is an empty place,' moving to the light, then being in a narrow place and pushing out (interpreted as birth).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'There is no other way. It is better to go to that life than to stay here.'
